Support Engineering is the technical bridge between frontline Support, Product, and Engineering. You’ll help define the standards and systems that let a small, highly technical team move quickly without sacrificing judgment or quality. About the role When a complex issue moves beyond frontline Support, Support Engineering investigates the problem using customer context, application behavior, logs, databases, integrations, APIs, and code-level context. The team determines whether the issue can be resolved through configuration, data correction, documentation, enablement, or an in-app change—or whether it is a product defect that Engineering needs to fix.
